course_review/1.card_source: opengolfapi card (Black/Blue 7525, Silver 7049; club site colberthills.com confirms 7,525 total). Page set 'Web' (7505) is an OpenGolfAPI artefact: identical to Black/Blue except hole 12 (414 vs 434).

holes.notes: Web (= Black/Blue) tee was walked back 27 yds along the hole line onto the clubhouse / parking area (desktop shot shows the marker off the turf). Put it on the back OSM tee box (the box Silver uses). Card 590 vs ~564 measured from that box: the card distance follows the dogleg; keep 590 on the card. The calm pick Driver +40 sits on the aim bound and lands in native rock/rough left of the right-side fairway; it should be re-solved from the real tee. Silver CHECK (564 vs 578) is the same measuring-path issue, not a wrong tee.
Tees on OSM tee boxes, measured yardage within 10 of the card for Web and Silver, par = card, calm pick lands on fairway (checked in the phone/desktop shots).

Web PASS. Silver Driver -40 lands 284 yds in rough 20 yds off fairway: dogleg-left hole (green 107 left), aim on the bound; plausible but a 3-wood/iron layup to the corner may be better. Geometry (tees, green, yardage) matches the card.

Tees on OSM boxes, yardage 488 vs card 494 (Web) / 478 = card (Silver). Silver Driver +18 flies the first fairway into the rough gap before the second fairway section (315 yds); a shorter club is the human play from Silver. Not a geometry error.

Web/Silver Driver +40 (on the aim bound) aims at the greenside bunker cluster: sand 30%, fairway 23%, ~48 yds in. The obvious play is a 4-wood/long iron to the big fairway on the left; the strokes edge for Driver is small (0.04-0.06). Tee, green and yardage are fine.
Silver Driver +16 lands 335 yds in rough 14 yds off fairway (end of fairway); Web PASS. Geometry matches the card.

Web (Black) tee is a lidar pad 19 yds behind the back OSM box; the Black card 237 needs a tee about that far back (Silver box measures exactly 214 = card), so the pad is probably a real unmapped tips box. Uncertain; par-3 view does not show the tee.

Dogleg left round the pond: the OSM hole line bends 71 yds left at 283 yds, but the tee line points straight at the green and the aim window (+/-40) cannot reach the fairway. The calm pick Driver +40 (on the bound) carries the pond and lands on/next to hole 9's green (50 yds right, 307 yds out). Needs the aim line along the hole line (aim_ll ~250 yds along the hole line) and hole 9's green treated as a no-go. Also: no OSM green polygon for 18 (green = hole-line end). Tees and yardage match the card.

course_notes: Solved set 'Web' should be Black/Blue (7525, the club's stated length); only hole 12 differs (434 vs 414). Request tees ['Black','Silver'] on rebuild.
OSM has no green polygon for hole 18 (green from hole-line end).
